# omission / concealment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventTypeOmission`](gmeow-eventTypeOmission.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventTypeOmission>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md), [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A deception event in which the held standpoint is present but no projected standpoint is offered — the deceiver suppresses a truth they hold rather than asserting its opposite. The absence of projection is the mechanism; the gap is informational, not propositional. Violates the Gricean maxim of [`Quantity`](../classes/gmeow-Quantity.md).
